consequences: No durable local checkout exists yet; a fresh clone (verified with --recurse-submodules) is the recovery path. The workspace model change needs a bitty-docs/umbrella AGENTS.md follow-up.
context: The workspace path $BITTY_WORKSPACE/bitty-plugins is a grouping directory holding four live plugin repositories with uncommitted changes and registered worktrees; initializing the new repository there would entangle active work.
decision_body: Create, gate, and push the new repository from /tmp/opencode/bitty-plugins; the durable workspace checkout is deferred until the grouping directory is retired.
title: Build and push from a /tmp checkout for the bootstrap

consequences: Metadata refresh is network-dependent and non-blocking; offline runs leave the index unchanged with a notice.
context: Registry entries must stay minimal and must not duplicate version/stars/dates; the store and future CLI must consume one artifact.
decision_body: scripts/sync-metadata.ts fetches bitty-plugin.toml (bounded, credential-free) and writes an optional metadata object into generated/registry.json; generate-index preserves it across regenerations and drops it for removed entries.
title: Derived manifest metadata lives only in generated/registry.json

consequences: Root devDependencies have no automated updates until the follow-up completes.
context: The bun ecosystem updater for this repository failed in its updater container on the first run.
decision_body: Ship dependabot.yml with github-actions updates only; track re-enabling bun in TODO.md. The npm updater stays excluded as known-broken.
title: Remove the Dependabot bun updater after a failed trial
